analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,136,000 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (1,265,200/1,326,750/1,580,165 KRW): Below short/mid-term trends, confirming bearish position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (1,785,927/1,509,124 KRW): Below long-term trends, maintaining bearish strength.
· 52-week position (31.5%) + Current price level is 3.9x the 52-week low, approaching historical low vicinity.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.9→33.2): Entered oversold territory, confirming strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (25070.2118→-11119.5018): Bearish crossover and convergence, signaling strengthening downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band 1,106,489 KRW): Approaching lower band, with a band width of 33.20% indicating potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (808,000 KRW): High level relative to 52-week low, significant distance from current price.
· Swing Resistance (1,587,000 KRW): High level relative to current price, potential for trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low / Lower High / Sideways): 5-day low 1,089,000, 20-day low 1,089,000, 5-day high 1,476,000, 20-day high 1,587,000. No clear pattern formation, confirming sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.01x vs 5-day average): Normal level, indicating moderate confidence in current movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Directional confirmation needed due to RSI entering oversold and ADX trend weakening, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
